messages:
maria: quick sync — building a token-econ surface for Console/Cost dashboard. We need runtime+infra inputs: per-request token counts, model latency, cache hits (KV/prefix), batch size, and routing tier. Who owns these signals?

_derek: Eng-platform owns the dashboard wiring. Instrumentation is infra. cc @kevin for telemetry schema._

kevin: I'm on it. Can you confirm required labels and aggregation windows? low-cardinality please. Proposed labels: `model_variant`, `region`, `route`, `customer_tier`, `cache_hit` (bool), `batch_size_bucket`.

sasha: Runtime: can emit `tokens_in`, `tokens_out`, `compute_ms`, `kv_cache_hit` per-request. We'll add `batch_id` when requests are batched. Note: routing policy (fallback->cheaper model) changes effective cost — include `effective_model` label.

maria: Use cases: 1) per-1k token cost rollups for billing roughness 2) cache/batch savings visualization 3) per-route SLA vs cost tradeoffs.

kevin: Draft metric names:
```
metric: token_cost_cents_total
labels: [customer_id, model_variant, effective_model, route, region, cache_hit, batch_size_bucket]
aggregation: sum by labels over 1m, 1h, 24h
```
Also emit `token_count` and `kv_cache_saved_tokens` to compute savings offline.

derek: Two implementation notes: a) limit `customer_id` to hashed id for high-cardinality b) add `sampling_rate` label if we downsample.

sasha: Will add `kv_cache_hit` boolean and `prefix_key` only sampled. Can't emit full prefix for PII reasons.

maria: Console UX: show "cost per 1k tokens (estimated)" panel + "cache and batching savings" stacked view. Also toggle to break down by route/model.

kevin: I'll push a proto telemetry spec to infra repo by EOD. Will include a prom-compatible counter + OTLP exporter. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/token-econ-spec (placeholder)

derek: Dashboard: I'll wire panels and a small rollout experiment (canary to 10% of routes). Need mock metrics for QA.

maria: ok. Action items:
- @kevin: telemetry spec + PR (due +3d)
- @sasha: runtime events + sample payloads (due +4d)
- @derek: dashboard panels + mock data (due +5d)

kevin: noted :thumbsup:

derek: adding a lightweight buzzer in the dashboard for 'show estimate method' :eyes:

maria: perfect — will sync in Thurs AM. Thanks everyone.
